## quark-lazy-cli v0.1.4

- No file changes detected in this release.
- SKILL.md content was not modified.
- No new features, bug fixes, or documentation updates included in this version.

- Improved SKILL.md environment variable configuration: clarified steps, split说明和操作,并强调.env不要放入全局目录
- 增强了.env配置部分的分层描述，对不同变量设置进行了详细注释，提升易用性
- 对环境变量优先级说明进行了补充，使临时覆盖和持久配置的逻辑更清晰
- 其余功能和CLI命令用法未更动

quark-lazy-cli v0.1.2

- Renamed skill to quark-lazy-cli and updated description for clarity.
- Refined and reorganized documentation for installation, configuration, usage, and best practices.
- Added four new reference guides covering advisor modes, scheduling, daily reports, and release time estimation in the "references" directory.
- Expanded instructions on advisor modes, CLI command usage, and strict rules for safe operation.
- Improved environment variable and runtime directory recommendations for better agent compatibility.

- Documentation (SKILL.md, README.md) updated to distinguish "Skill 文档" from the actual CLI; instructions now clearly separate installing the skill for OpenClaw Agent vs installing the functional CLI.
- All environment variable and configuration paths now recommend using a dedicated ".quark-lazy-cli" directory within the skill folder instead of a flat shared directory.
- All example commands and configuration references updated to use the new `<skill>/.quark-lazy-cli/.env` pattern for improved clarity and isolation.
- Added sample shell scripts for status checking and reporting.
- Minor updates/refactoring across source files and project metadata to align with new documentation and directory conventions.
- The skill name in documentation clarified from "quark-lazy-cli" to "qslazy" for consistency.

Initial release of quark-lazy-cli.

- Provides agents with tools to manage QAS-based Quark drive subscriptions for anime, dramas, and shows.
- Supports installing/configuring qslazy, inspecting subscription status, and updating missing/new episodes after user authorization.
- Analyzes release timings and suggests optimal recurring update schedules.
- Handles complex resource selection with advisor modes (code, llm, agent, human).
- Includes detailed guidance on setup, safe operating principles, advisor usage, and integration with external tools.
